name: Manabolt Convergence lets the targeted Aethercharge card be activated from the graveyard until end of turn
notes: Manabolt Convergence targets Charge the Soul (an Aethercharge) in the graveyard; clicking it there then activates it (paying its reserve cost of 1) and its 1 damage hits the opposing champion. The permission is spent by that activation, so a second click on the card in the graveyard is refused.

rulesClauses: Until end of turn, you may activate target Aethercharge card in your graveyard. (You still pay its costs.)

engineBug.summary: FIXED. Manabolt Convergence's 'you may activate target Aethercharge card in your graveyard' sentence was a TODO stub.
